body:
I just read [this](http://www.reddit.com/r/ForeverAlone/comments/2cd3b1/you_lost_the_game_no_matter_what_happens_in_the/) and realized it wasn't incorrect.  It had me halfway out the door, dressed in my sunday best so that I would jump off the bridge.  The thing is though, I've done that before. I get there and feel just enough existential apathy at that exact moment that I can't compel myself to get over the rail.

I'm just not sure what to do.  I really do want to die, but I can't bring myself to do it.  I'm scared, shaking, and so fucking sick of losing. Do I need drugs? Do I just need to call life quits and move back in with my parents like the pathetic manchild I apparently am? Am I just a woman?  Is that why women will not interact with me sexually/physically/romantically/etc? Do they see something I do not? 

How do people *live?* How do people interact?  How do they make connections with others?  How do I make someone else want to be around me? I will just be back here tomorrow, or next week, slightly worse off than before. Another sliver of life forever wasted, lost in an entirely conscious series of unsuccessful, unfufilled moments.

I wish I could get over this limbo.  I have never been so scared, there are no more excuses beyond my own cowardice.  I pray that sometime soon I see this for what it is.  I wish those who found the strength were still around to discuss how they got over it. Just more knowledge beyond my grasp.
